job_description.title: Senior Automation Test Engineer
job_description.jd_text: We are seeking a Senior Automation Test Engineer with 4 to 7 years of experience in test automation frameworks. The candidate must have expert Selenium WebDriver skills for web UI automation, Cucumber for BDD test framework development and Gherkin scenarios, TestNG for test suite management and parallel execution, Appium for mobile test automation on iOS and Android, and Java as the core automation scripting language. Preferred skills include Jenkins for CI/CD integration of test suites, Perfecto for cloud-based device testing, Git for test code version control, Jira for defect tracking, and REST API testing with Postman or RestAssured. Location: Pune with WFH or Hybrid arrangement.

job_description.title: Performance and Security Test Engineer
job_description.jd_text: We are looking for a Performance and Security Test Engineer with 4 to 6 years of experience. The candidate must have JMeter for load and stress testing of web applications, LoadRunner for enterprise-scale performance scenario design, OWASP ZAP for automated security scanning and vulnerability assessment, Selenium for web UI regression validation during load tests, and Python for scripting custom performance and security test scenarios. Preferred skills include general Automation Testing experience, Grafana for performance metrics visualisation, Prometheus for metrics collection, Burp Suite for manual penetration testing, and Jenkins for pipeline integration. Location: Pune, Hybrid work model.
